_doc: Set compat-resolve-1122 (docs/328 §7, queue compat-rules-proof-1122 group R): mods whose override skips one of our EA fixes and gets that fix at run time (CompatResolve.cs). The Store Updates 021-040 / 041-051 repacks and NRaas Overwatch V123 (same bytes as the download) are already in the test install. Build: node tools/mod-set.ts build docs/data/compat-resolve-1122.json -> game-copy/mod-sets/compat-resolve-1122 (git-ignored). Sources local only (game-copy/compat-mods, MTS downloads), never re-hosted.
